description: R08 host HistoryTests lifecycle checkpoint: safe Rust owns bounded per-application history allocation, detach/reattach persistence, case-insensitive app identity and resize behavior. Seven lifecycle/capacity contracts are Exact; the four duplicate-add policy methods remain Missing for the next coherent slice.

entries.notes: CommandHistoryStore allocates one attached history, preserves the stored app buffer after free, clears only the process attachment, and keeps the history count unchanged.
The configured four-history limit rejects a fifth application while all existing buffers are allocated, preserving all first-four lookups and the bounded store size.
Detaching and reattaching the same application with a different opaque process token restores the retained ten-command history.
When every configured history is both allocated and full, another application cannot steal a list and the store remains at the configured limit.
Application identity comparison is case-insensitive, matching the native ordinal-ignore-case observable for the Microsoft vector.
Growing capacity preserves all currently stored commands and their order, then allows the larger buffer to fill to the requested size.
Shrinking capacity truncates the tail and preserves the first five commands in the same order as native vector resize.
